name: NewsAPI.org
rate_limits: Free Developer plan: 100 requests a day (source: https://newsapi.org/pricing).
history_start: Free plan searches articles up to a month old.
what_it_has: Headlines and articles from many news sites, searchable by keyword. Free articles are delayed 24 hours.
simple: A news search service with a free plan that is only for testing, not real use.
license_terms: Developer plan is for development and testing only and cannot be used in staging or production, even internally. https://newsapi.org/pricing
quality_notes: One month of history is far too short for backtests. No sentiment scores.

relevance.reason: Too short and too restricted for research use.
